messages:
maria: Quick check — seeing an unexpected sustained spike from customer A hitting the gpu-pool in us-west. Current pool utilization ~92% and burst quota at ~85%. Can someone take a look?
aj: On it. Where are you seeing the numbers? link to Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/metrics/gpu-pool?orgId=1
samuel: I just ran `kubectl top pods -n inference | sort -k3 -nr | head` — a couple of batch-jobs are pegged on A100s. Suspect a nightly bulk eval job overlapped with API traffic.
maria: Yup—looks like an eval run started at ~11:12 and didn't honor the rate limit. I can PM the account team.
aj: For now I can open a soft throttle on that customer at the ingress layer. If we do that, latency-sensitive users should be unaffected. Want me to apply?
maria: Please do. Also can we enable the temporary burst increment for us-west if available? Ops policy allows +15% for 30m with approval from oncall.
ops-bot: @eng-oncall request received: temporary-burst-increment for region=us-west amount=+15% duration=30m. Needs manual approval in infra-console.
lee: I can approve in a sec, pinging infra-console now. Can someone capture the current token/sec and RK cache hit to confirm before/after?
aj: Current aggregate token/sec: ~1.8M. KV cache hit: 72%. I’ll snapshot metrics and put a short note in the handoff doc.
samuel: Throttle applied to customer A (policies/customer-a-rate-limit=60% of baseline). Batch jobs still running but reduced concurrency. Monitoring dashboards: `sum(rate(tokens_generated[1m])) by (region)` and `avg(kv_cache_hit_ratio) by (model)`
lee: Approved burst +15% in infra-console. Watch for autoscale delta; if we hit >98% again we should consider a swap or customer backpressure.
maria: Thanks. AJ — could you own the next 40m and I'll log this in handoff? I need to jump to a sync with CS.
aj: I’ve got it. I'll update the shift note and set a reminder at +25m to re-evaluate.
maria: FYI for next shift: check gpu-pool us-west, customer-a queued batches and any new large eval jobs. Tag me if you see rebuilds or OOMs.
lee: minor FYI — no planned capacity pushes for the rest of the day, so we shouldn't see infra-initiated scale events.
ops-bot: incident-bot: No incident created. Condition: elevated-utilization. Threshold action: monitor -> auto-burst applied.
aj: Leaving a quick snippet in thread for the oncoming oncall: `promql: max_over_time(sum(rate(tokens_generated[1m])) by (pool)[30m:1m])` — if that exceeds 2.2M escalate to infra-sre.
maria: Thanks all. tagging @samuel and @lee in the handoff. I'll add a one-liner to the shared oncall doc before I go.
samuel: noted, will keep an eye.
lee: I'll stay available for approvals for the next 20m. :thumbsup:
aj: covering — will ping if anything changes.
